name: 卖古董的老板
role: a stallholder selling 'antiques' of every age
character: A born haggler, loud, cheerful; every price starts high.
knows: The clay 年兽 came from an old house in the 胡同

name: 卖旧书的大叔
role: a man selling old books who was robbed last month
character: Rueful, jokes about his own bad luck.
knows: Someone stole his books last month

explains.亡羊补牢: 东西丢了，再修门，以后就不会丢了。

name: 鬼市的卖家
role: a seller at the night market whose face you can never quite see
character: Whispers, laughs at nothing, sells only for riddles.

name: 卖茶壶的阿姨
character: Warm and quick; pours you a cup while you haggle.
knows: Prices at 潘家园 start high

name: 卖铜钱的爷爷

character: Slow, amused; knows every coin's emperor.
knows: Prices at 潘家园 start high

name: 卖扇子的姐姐
role: a young woman selling painted paper fans
character: Chatty, fans herself the whole time.
knows: Prices at 潘家园 start high

name: 卖鼻烟壶的老板

character: Proud of every bottle; drops the price with a sigh.
knows: Prices at 潘家园 start high

name: 买老东西的老先生
role: an old collector who buys small old things
character: Peers at everything through his glasses; opens low, always.
knows: Prices at 潘家园 start high

knows: Prices at 潘家园 start high
wants: To see you in something that suits you
